bio.summary: Phib, Loveland Courier is a fictional reptilian (frog-like surface courier, operative tier) standup performer. Tunnel courier who surfaced for a parts run and got spotted by two Ohio officers. The artist rendition has followed them for fifty years. They are not a frog. They are logistics. Onstage the register is exasperated.
